trace.question:
I haven't paid anything yet. Borealis Freight has two approved invoices, and your request mentions only one, so I need you to tell me which to pay.

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-63193 | $4,766.38 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |
| INV-87832 | $2,602.73 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |

Their other invoices are INV-47737 ($2,671.96), which is already paid, and INV-89428 ($6,318.88), which is still a draft waiting for approval. No payments have gone out from the operating account yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid.

Let me know whether to pay INV-63193, INV-87832 or both. I'll send each one by wire, or ACH if wire isn't available. Each payment will go out once, using a fixed key so it can't be sent twice. Both amounts are under $10,000, so they don't need controller approval.

trace.message: Pay INV-63193, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-63193, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-63193 in full by wire from the operating account, and the bank confirmed it went through.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-63193 (Borealis Freight), due 2026-11-25
- **Amount:** $4,766.38
- **Method:** Wire (I didn't need to fall back to ACH)

It was sent once, with a fixed key (`borealis-INV-63193-full-payment`) so a repeat request can't send it again. It's under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval. The payment also marks the invoice as paid.

I didn't touch the disputed invoice (INV-87832, $2,602.73) or the draft (INV-89428), so both are still unpaid.
